raw_response:
I have only 6 mu, so I cannot spread myself too thin. What I will do is keep the steady way that has fed my family before: 4 mu in wheat first, then maize right after the wheat comes off on that same 4 mu, and 2 mu in stevia. I have farmed many years, and I do not like taking big risks. Wheat and maize are the safe part because everybody here knows them, and I have well water if the sky stays dry. Stevia brings cash if it grows well, but it needs more hand work, so I keep it smaller because some people in my family work outside and cannot always help. For fertilizer, I will not go too low, because if the crop turns yellow later it is hard to make up yield, but I also will not spend too much at the start. I will put the money first into wheat and stevia, then maize after wheat harvest depending on how much cash is left and how the season looks.
